title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook spaghetti according to package directions.
While pasta cooks, fry the pancetta in a large skillet until crispy.
In a bowl, whisk together eggs, grated Parmesan, and black pepper.
Drain pasta, reserving 1 cup of pasta water.
Add hot pasta to the skillet with pancetta, remove from heat.
Quickly stir in the egg mixture, adding pasta water as needed to create a creamy sauce.
Serve immediately with extra Parmesan and black pepper.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken (tikka) cooked in a smooth buttery & creamy tomato based gravy.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and half the tikka masala spice for at least 1 hour.
Grill or pan-fry marinated chicken until cooked through.
In a large pan, melt butter and sauté onions until golden.
Add garlic and remaining spices, cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato sauce and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in cream and cooked chicken, simmer for 5 more minutes.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with rice or naan.

title: Caesar Salad
summary: A fresh salad with romaine lettuce, croutons, parmesan cheese, and Caesar dressing.
instructions: Wash and dry romaine lettuce thoroughly.
Tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces and place in a large bowl.
Add Caesar dressing and toss to coat evenly.
Add croutons and half the Parmesan cheese, toss again.
Transfer to serving plates.
Top with remaining Parmesan shavings and anchovy fillets if desired.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges.

title: Beef Tacos
summary: Delicious tacos filled with seasoned ground beef, lettuce, cheese, and salsa.
instructions: Brown ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Drain excess fat and add taco seasoning with water as per packet instructions.
Simmer for 5 minutes until sauce thickens.
Warm taco shells according to package directions.
Fill each shell with seasoned beef.
Top with lettuce, cheese, salsa, sour cream, and diced tomatoes.
Serve immediately while hot.

title: Margherita Pizza
summary: Classic Italian pizza topped with tomatoes, mozzarella cheese, fresh basil, and olive oil.
instructions: Preheat oven to 475°F (245°C) with pizza stone if available.
Roll out pizza dough on a floured surface to desired thickness.
Spread tomato sauce evenly, leaving a border for the crust.
Arrange mozzarella slices over the sauce.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with salt.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until crust is golden and cheese is bubbly.
Remove from oven, top with fresh basil leaves, and serve hot.

title: Chocolate Brownies
summary: Rich and fudgy chocolate brownies perfect for dessert lovers.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a 9x9 inch baking pan with parchment paper.
Melt chocolate and butter together in a double boiler or microwave.
Stir in sugar until well combined and let cool slightly.
Beat in eggs one at a time, then add vanilla extract.
Sift in flour, cocoa powder, and salt, fold gently until just combined.
Pour batter into prepared pan and smooth the top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until a toothpick comes out with moist crumbs.
Cool completely before cutting into squares.
